verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains only relative marketing multipliers (e.g., 'up to 2X faster inference', '110X faster than CPU', '1.9X faster Llama2') and memory bandwidth/capacity specs, but no actual TFLOPS/TOPS figures broken out by precision (FP8, FP16, TF32, INT8, etc.) or with sparsity stated — exactly the 'bare marketing number' pattern the story warns against. No spec sheet or datasheet citation with per-precision/sparsity throughput numbers is present.
